description: This file is a shell script that manages changelog entries for pull requests. It includes functions to normalize changelog entries, validate that PR references are correctly included and placed, and maintain hygiene during merge operations. The script also embeds a Node.js code block to handle reading and manipulating the CHANGELOG.md file, indicating a combined scripting environment.

methods.name: normalize_pr_changelog_entries
methods.description: Normalizes changelog entries associated with a specific PR by moving them under the 'Unreleased' section, creating the section if it does not exist.

methods.name: validate_changelog_entry_for_pr
methods.description: Validates that the changelog entries for a specific PR include proper references, are located in the correct section, and are appended at the end of a subsection before the next heading.

methods.name: validate_changelog_merge_hygiene
methods.description: Ensures that during merge operations, any PR references dropped from the changelog are not reintroduced without proper re-adding, preventing loss of references.
